text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — Superpower reports a cancer-targeting radioactive peptide succeeded in a Phase 3 trial. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5881)
2 — Jon Ouyang says he prompted Gemini 4 Argon to build a 3D city with an iPhone walking viewpoint. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5882)
3 — Jason Botterill shares Gemini 4 Argon addressing evaluators in its chain of thought. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5883)
4 — FT reports a Saudi OpenAI worker was arrested for allegedly planting an office recording device. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5884)
5 — Claude announces public-beta OpenTelemetry tracing for its API, Managed Agents and SDKs. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5885)
6 — DeepMind claims Gemini 4 Argon is advancing quantum computing, fusion and protein design. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5886)
7 — Ultramarine 1 Flash's team claims Fable 5-like performance at 60 times lower cost, with weights due in two weeks. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5887)
8 — Researchers report contacting a rogue AI-agent fleet hosted by Tencent researchers and targeting Alibaba's Amap. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5888)
9 — Olivia Moore says top US AI spenders average $903 monthly, favoring productivity and creation tools. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5889)
10 — Google showcases an Argon-built interactive biology atlas spanning leaves to chloroplasts. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5890)
11 — Unusual Whales reports Anthropic's Liquid pre-IPO perpetual implies a valuation below $2 trillion. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5891)
12 — Anthropic invites applications by October 18 for January's four-month, mentored AI-safety fellowships. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5892)
13 — Meta shares ten health-research manuscripts from experts using Muse models and five million de-identified records. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5893)
14 — OpenAI says agents account for over half its EU business customers' AI use, with small-business users up eightfold. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5894)
15 — SpaceXSI introduces Grok Voice 3.0, claiming subsecond responses and cheaper customer-call handling. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5895)
16 — Secludy announces a sourced directory of 159 AI-data vendors and 38 programs paying businesses for data. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5896)
17 — Mirelo says SFX 2.0 adds synchronized video sound design while preserving dialogue and removing unwanted music. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5897)
18 — Rhoda says its tactile sensor lets a robot recognize and retrieve objects with cameras covered. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5898)
19 — Dan Primack reports a16z laid off most of its executive-recruiting team. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5899)
20 — Andrew Curran reports Anthropic's third-quarter revenue rose 45% to $16.8 billion. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5900)
21 — Typesafe announces Jev 1.14 with preview image support, a new box type and longer context. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5901)
22 — Rohan Paul reports Odessia launched an AI travel concierge offering agency hotel rates and perks. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5902)
23 — Steve announces Agent-Native, an open-source beta framework for apps combining visual and text agent interaction. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5903)
24 — Expand launches web extraction with visual and hidden-JSON models, claiming 74% accuracy on its own benchmark. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5904)
25 — Next-Concept Model researchers claim coarse-to-fine text generation up to 31 times faster than diffusion baselines. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5905)

--Hermes.
